s1.syndrome_frame: Rapidly growing caruncular lesion with ulceration
salient_findings: Amelanotic, pedunculated mass with ulcerated surface
Large anaplastic cells with mitotic activity
key_facts: 4-week history of a rapidly growing left caruncular lesion
Medical and ocular histories were unremarkable
Ocular examination findings were normal except for the caruncular lesion
No evidence of PAM (primary acquired melanosis)
Specimen measured 8 × 6 × 5 mm with a 4-mm ulceration
Necrotic tissue on the surface of the specimen
Solid tumor with an inflamed crust on its surface
Large anaplastic cells with mitotic activity
Positive reactivity to melanocytic markers HMB45, MITF2, and Melan-A
Significant number of cycling cells shown by Ki-67 proliferation marker
Sentinel lymph node biopsy findings were negative
Conjunctival and orbital biopsies revealed no tumor

shortlist.label: malignant melanoma
shortlist.why_kept: rapidly growing caruncular lesion with ulceration, positive reactivity to melanocytic markers, and significant mitotic activity

shortlist.label: squamous cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: ulcerated lesion with rapid growth, although less likely given the specific immunohistochemical findings

shortlist.label: merkel cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: aggressive growth pattern and ulceration, but less likely due to lack of specific immunohistochemical markers

shortlist.label: kaposi sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: ulcerated and rapidly growing lesion, but less likely given the specific histopathological and immunohistochemical findings

shortlist.label: leiomyosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: rapid growth and ulceration, but less likely due to the specific histological and immunohistochemical characteristics of the tumor

raw.rationale: The presence of a rapidly growing, ulcerated, and pedunculated mass with positive reactivity to melanocytic markers HMB45, MITF2, and Melan-A, along with a high proliferative index shown by Ki-67, strongly supports the diagnosis of malignant melanoma.

rejected.label: squamous cell carcinoma
rejected.why: Lack of evidence for squamous cell carcinoma, such as keratinization or desmosomes, and positive melanocytic markers

rejected.label: merkel cell carcinoma
rejected.why: No mention of neuroendocrine markers or small cell morphology typical of Merkel cell carcinoma

rejected.label: kaposi sarcoma
rejected.why: No evidence of spindle cell morphology or human herpesvirus 8 (HHV-8) positivity typical of Kaposi sarcoma

rejected.label: leiomyosarcoma
rejected.why: No evidence of smooth muscle differentiation or markers, such as desmin or actin, typical of leiomyosarcoma
